name: Mixdor 2-in-1 Panini Press and Waffle Maker
description: Two-in-one contact grill with swappable plates: use the ribbed grill plates for panini, toasted sandwiches and meat, or swap in the waffle plates to make four square waffles at once. Digital touch controls with temperature and timer settings.

name: Silicone Travel Bottle
description: Collapsible silicone travel bottle for water and drinks. Folds down flat when empty to save space in a bag, then pops back up to fill. Comes in assorted colours.

name: 4-Grid Silicone Soap, Ice & Chocolate Mold
description: Flexible silicone mold with four shapes (square, round, heart and oval) for homemade soap, ice, chocolate, jelly and treats. Food-safe silicone that pops out easily and is simple to wash.

name: Silicone Air Fryer Liner
description: Reusable round silicone liner for air fryer baskets. Keeps the basket clean, stops food from sticking and lifts out by its handles. Heat resistant and reusable in place of paper liners.

name: 2-Grid Silicone Soup Freezer Mold
description: Two-compartment silicone freezer mold with a lid for portioning and freezing soup, stew, sauce and broth. Frozen blocks push out easily, and the lid keeps the tray stackable in the freezer.

name: 4-Grid Silicone Freezer Tray
description: Four-compartment silicone freezer tray with a lid for freezing soup, stew, sauce and baby food in neat portions. Flexible base pushes frozen blocks out easily; trays stack in the freezer.

name: 15-Grid Silicone Ice Mold
description: Silicone ice cube tray with 15 cubes and a lid. Flexible, so the cubes pop out easily. Comes in assorted colours.

name: Iron Shoe
description: Iron shoe (soleplate cover) that fits over the bottom of your iron. Lets you iron delicate and dark fabrics without scorching or leaving shiny marks, and protects the soleplate.

name: Avinas Mid-Range Commercial Juicer AV-7028
description: Mid-range commercial juicer for juice bars, restaurants and busy homes. Stainless steel body with a tall feed chute. Weighs about 8.2 kg.

name: Avinas Heavy Duty Domestic Juicer AV-7026
description: Heavy duty juicer for home use, with a tall feed chute for whole fruit and vegetables. Weighs about 6.1 kg.

name: Avinas Double Infrared Cooker
description: Two-burner electric infrared cooker with separate digital touch controls for each plate. Works with any cookware, including clay and aluminium pots. Side handles for easy carrying.

name: Avinas Dough Mixer 8.8L AV-8066
description: 3-in-1 fufu machine and dough mixer with an 8.8-litre stainless steel pot. Pounds fufu, kneads dough and proofs dough. 1000 W motor with digital controls.

name: Avinas Single Infrared Cooker AV-711
description: Single-plate electric infrared cooker. Works with any cookware, including clay and aluminium pots.

name: 6-Piece Wooden Ladle Set
description: Set of six wooden cooking utensils: spoons, slotted spoon, spatula and ladles. Natural wood is gentle on non-stick pots and does not get hot while you stir.

name: Sonifer Rice Cooker 13L SF-4040
description: Large 13-litre electric rice cooker that cooks up to 5 kg of dry rice, for big families, events and catering. Automatic keep-warm.

name: Sonifer Waffle Maker SF-6185
description: 1200 W waffle maker that bakes two heart-shaped waffles at once. Non-stick plates and an adjustable temperature dial.

name: Sonifer Pizza Maker 30cm SF-6086
description: Electric pizza maker with a 30 cm non-stick plate for pizza, pancakes, omelettes and flatbread. Timer dial. Measures 36 cm across and 13 cm high.

name: Sonifer Enamel Pot Rice Cooker SF-4055
description: Electric rice cooker with an enamel inner pot. Comes with a measuring cup and rice spoon.

name: Sonifer Steam Carpet Cleaner SF-2264
description: 4-in-1 steam carpet cleaner for carpets, rugs, sofas, mattresses and car seats. Separate clean and dirty water tanks, a flexible hose and several brush heads.

name: Sonifer Rice Cooker 23L SF-4053
description: Extra-large 23-litre electric rice cooker that cooks up to 10 kg of dry rice, for events, restaurants and catering. Automatic keep-warm.

name: Sonifer Pancake Maker 18 Holes SF-6126
description: 1350 W multi crepe maker with 18 non-stick holes for mini pancakes, poffertjes, blinis and fried eggs.

name: Sonifer Stand Mixer 12L SF-8082
description: 2000 W stand mixer with a 12-litre stainless steel bowl. Comes with a whisk, flat beater, dough hook and splash guard.

name: Sonifer Stand Mixer 16L SF-8220
description: Extra-large 2800 W stand mixer with a 16-litre stainless steel bowl. Comes with a whisk, flat beater, dough hook and splash guard.

name: Sonifer Food Dehydrator 10 Trays SF-4058
description: Stainless steel food dehydrator with 10 trays and a glass door, for drying fruit, vegetables, meat, fish and herbs. 620 W, adjustable from 30 to 70 °C, with touch controls.

name: Mixdor Donut Maker
description: Electric mini donut maker that bakes 16 small donuts at once. Non-stick plates.

name: Mixdor Mini Blender
description: Compact countertop blender for smoothies, shakes and small batches.

name: Mixdor Cordless Iron MX-7006
description: Cordless steam iron with a rose gold ceramic soleplate. Use it on its charging base with the cord or lift it off and iron wireless. 250 ml water tank, four temperature settings, a 360° rotating base, and dry or vertical steam ironing.

name: Zepline 7-in-1 Sandwich Maker ZP-811
description: 2200 W multifunction sandwich maker with 7 swappable plate sets, including sandwich, grill, waffle and donut plates.

name: Mixdor Coffee Grinder
description: Electric coffee grinder with a removable stainless steel bowl, for coffee beans as well as spices, pepper and other dry ingredients. Comes with a cleaning spatula.

name: Mixdor Double-Sided Crepe Maker MX-5033
description: Electric crepe and pancake maker with two cooking plates: one flat plate for large crepes and one with round sections for pancakes and fried eggs. Non-stick, with an adjustable thermostat.

name: Mixdor Electric Oven 60L MX-27001-60
description: 60-litre electric oven with convection fan, rotisserie fork and interior light, for baking, roasting and grilling.
